summary: Completed frontend testing of POS Modal (نقطة البيع) responsive redesign on /parts page. All features working correctly on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) viewports. Tabs navigation, Next/Prev buttons, data loading (onFocus), and all form interactions work as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: POS Modal (PartsTransactionModal.jsx) fully tested. Responsive design works on desktop and mobile. Tabs (العملية/الربط/السلة) work correctly. Next/Prev step buttons work. Transaction types (sale/purchase/direct) work. onFocus data loading for vehicles, partners, accounts, and parts works. No horizontal overflow on mobile. Add/Remove item functionality works.
verified_features: POS button opens modal from /parts page
Modal title 'نقطة البيع والعمليات المباشرة' displays correctly
Three tabs visible: العملية (1), الربط (2), السلة (3)
Tab navigation via clicking tabs works
Next button (التالي) navigates to next tab
Prev button (السابق) navigates to previous tab
Transaction type dropdown (بيع/شراء/عملية مباشرة) works
Sale mode dropdown (بيع فوري/مركبة) appears for sale type
Vehicle select appears when sale mode is 'vehicle'
Direct operation shows amount and description inputs
Partner select (customer/supplier) works based on transaction type
Account select loads accounts on focus
Part select loads parts on focus (87 parts loaded)
Add item button (+ إضافة قطعة أخرى) adds new item row
Remove item button (حذف البند) removes item row
Refresh button (تحديث القوائم) triggers data reload
Total calculation displays correctly
Submit button text changes based on transaction type
Direct operation shows summary message instead of items section
No horizontal overflow on mobile viewport
All data-testid attributes present and working
